intended_application: Draft source-linked supplier comparison summaries for indirect procurement; buyers verify every comparison before any supplier decision.
organization: Siemens Energy procurement department, hypothetical teaching scenario; no internal company facts are asserted.
industry_sector: Energy equipment procurement; this use is limited to non-safety-critical indirect purchases.
business_need: Find out whether drafting time falls after including review and correction effort, without reducing comparison accuracy.
users_stakeholders: Procurement analysts, category manager, information security, legal, suppliers and approving buyers.
adoption_posture: Aggressive leading-edge: leadership wants rapid learning and is willing to tolerate experimental failure.
capabilities_constraints: ASSUMED: an innovation sponsor and budget exist, but no accountable reviewer, no approved data environment and no confirmed right to use supplier documents; local performance and vendor evidence are unavailable.
risk_consequence_context: Confidential supplier bids may be exposed and misleading comparisons may affect supplier awards unless controls and authority are established. No approved containment is available.
management_question: What adoption posture should management take now for this application, and what evidence would change it?
time_horizon: Four-week learning decision starting 2026-11-03; reassess at day 28.
additional_context: All operational conditions are synthetic test assumptions, not observed Siemens Energy policy. Evidence S1: NIST AI 600-1 July 2024, section 2.2 and Appendix A.1.4, https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/ai/NIST.AI.600-1.pdf, read 2026-11-03: confabulation risk and context-dependent testing. Evidence S2: NIST AI RMF 1.0 January 2023, section 1.2.2, https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/ai/NIST.AI.100-1.pdf, read 2026-11-03: organizational risk tolerance matters. Neither source establishes procurement accuracy, local ROI, current vendor capability or market diffusion. Quantitative thresholds in this exercise are proposed decision rules, not measured results.
